title: 第318章 番外历练皇子第317章 番外傻福皇帝
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
【右仆射：？】
【左仆射：？】
房谋杜断都是愣了一下。
【隋世宗：没错，朱剑济死了之后，皇位只能归见深。】
【隋世宗：不过朱剑济死的不明不白，背后没有太后发力我是不信的，所以也不算抢。】
杨璎这方面轻车熟路，立马给众人解释起其中因果。
“这小子很灵活啊。”
皇帝反而是记下了韦皋这个名字，摸了摸下巴。
远方，正在思索的韦皋，忽然打了个冷颤。
感觉自己好像被什么不得了的存在盯上了。
【子夫：杨璎，你给你兄长葬哪了？】
子夫现在对于这些或暴或昏或庸的君主，起了十分浓厚的兴趣。
【隋世宗：忘了，好像是哪片荒地吧，随便挖个墓室就给埋了。】
杨璎毫不避讳，直接说了出来。
【子夫：？】
【子夫：该像人的时候，你又不像人了。】
子夫抓住机会，毫不客气嘲讽起来。
【隋世宗：我和杨勇是不死不休的关系，没给他尸骨丢了就不错了。】
杨璎面对这嘲讽，不仅没有不好意思，反而毫不客气回击。
【子夫：那你也好意思嘲讽堡宗？】

子夫被整笑了，追着杨璎杀。
【隋世宗：第一，杨勇对皇朝无功，但景泰让皇朝稳住了，那个废物才能复辟。】
【隋世宗：第二，杨勇极尽奢靡，对于皇朝无功可言，对于我更是没有恩义可言。
我需要给他面子？】
杨璎发出的评论那叫一个理直气壮。
她内心也是这么想的。
【子夫：那这么说，你对杨宿很好了？】
子夫想到什么，继续追着杨璎杀。
【隋世宗：那不然呢，我只是私底下问药师，他到底死没死。】
【隋世宗：卫家对武帝帮助那么大，卫家最后的结局一定很好吧？】
【子夫：......】
【仲卿：......】
【隋世宗：说白了，要不是杨玄敢谋反，我还在重用杨家。】
【隋世宗：请问卫家在哪发财呢？】
杨璎并没有放过子夫，拿着剑追着她杀。
李君器看到这里，忽然笑了。
杨璎这话倒是真心实意，虽然她逼死了杨宿，但对于杨玄敢依旧重用。
杨玄敢一开始担任鸿胪卿，后又转任礼部尚书，同时负责粮草运输。
无论从任何角度看，杀父仇人任用被杀者的儿子，还委以重任，十分抽象。
但杨璎本人不这么想。

Yang Ying was very familiar with this aspect and immediately explained the cause and effect to everyone.
"This guy is very flexible."
Instead, the emperor wrote down the name Wei Gao and touched his chin.
In the distance, Wei Gao, who was thinking, suddenly shuddered.
It felt like I was being targeted by something terrible.
[Zihu: Yang Ying, where did you bury your brother? 】
Zifu now became very interested in these monarchs, who were either violent, stupid or mediocre.
[Sui Shizong: I forgot, it seems to be some kind of wasteland. I just dug a tomb and buried it. 】
Yang Ying didn't shy away and said it directly.
[Zihu:? 】
[Zihu: When you should be like a human being, you no longer look like a human being. 】
Zifu seized the opportunity and mocked him unceremoniously.
[Sui Shizong: Yang Yong and I have a life-or-death relationship. It’s good that we didn’t lose his body. 】
Faced with this ridicule, Yang Ying not only did not feel embarrassed, but she responded unceremoniously.
[Zihu: Then you have the nerve to ridicule Baozong? 】
Zifu was laughed at and chased Yang Ying to kill her.
[Sui Shizong: First, Yang Yong did nothing to the dynasty, but Jingtai stabilized the dynasty, and that waste could be restored. 】
[Sui Shizong: Second, Yang Yong is extremely extravagant and has no merit to the dynasty, and he has no kindness to me.
Do I need to give him face? 】
Yang Ying's comment was so justified.
She thought so in her heart.
[Zifu: So, you are very good to Yang Su? 】
Zifu thought of something and continued to chase Yang Ying.
[Sui Shizong: That's not the case. I just asked the pharmacist privately whether he was dead or not. 】
[Sui Shizong: The Wei family helped Emperor Wu so much, the Wei family must have a good ending, right? 】
【Zihu:......】
[Zhongqing:......]
[Sui Shizong: To put it bluntly, if Yang Xuan had not dared to rebel, I would still be re-employing the Yang family. 】
[Sui Shizong: Where did the Wei family make their fortune? 】
Yang Ying did not let Zifu go and chased her with a sword to kill her.
Li Junqi suddenly smiled when he saw this.
Yang Ying's words were sincere. Although she forced Yang Su to death, she still valued Yang Xuangan.
Yang Xuangan first served as Hongluqing, and later transferred to the position of Minister of Rites, where he was also responsible for the transportation of grain and grass.
No matter from any angle, it is very abstract that the enemy who killed his father appoints the son of the murdered man and entrusts him with important responsibilities.
But Yang Ying herself doesn’t think so.
